notes.title: New Units, Map Update & Monster Buff II
notes.content:
Hello, bold destroyers of the Empire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/ba194cac9471d1c46d4b81b9d4f3157d78b3ff9e.png[/img]

We've updated the campaign map, adding a second bonus level (the Oasis) plus made some alternative swamp levels into new fully separate ones.

Our monster cat has received further buffs, especially to various upgrades. Melee attack hit boxes have been made a little bigger, all negative status durations have been reduced, and the visual effects of being poisoned do not alter camera view any more.

The imperial forces have been boosted by 7 new types of variety units. They have already joined imperial armies in various levels throughout the campaign, here are some details of 5 of them:

The Imperial Cook
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/124237c30588b2b27427d8dee20be7d56d76c287.png[/img]

The Living Metal Axehead Rammer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/2e2f1089f02c2fce43eb59ab76164d5689114638.png[/img]

The Bear Hunter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/e0848b46e0ab8d59c5ee7f3489d6d1b1b363a4e0.png[/img]

The Golden Zweihander
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/986643001ac2519720629205f3b5dfdd11b5c9c6.png[/img]

The Elder Noble
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/af4f1174aed5263fe454c827ad3700717e642e93.png[/img]

Additionally, the barbarian warrior weapon was replaced with a long war billhook, about twice as long as their previous trident.

More variety units are in the works.

P.S. a bit of background lore:
The monster cat never cared the slightest about what names the humans give to their empire or any other forces of greed & domination. The cat knows the name is just another fancy label for something simply bad. That's why the Empire is consistently called "the empire" (with a noncapital e) in the game, and that's why it's specific name is never mentioned.

notes.title: Monster Cat Buff, version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who was bold enough to try the 1st version!

You're our heroes because you ventured into a hostile, unknown realm despite the well-known fact that fresh universes may come with glitches and oddities! Fortunately, no true deadly anomalies have been encountered so far...

We were worried the fine experience of crushing and slashing imperial footmen would be too easy, but turns out it was actually a little too deadly and rough - thank you for the fast feedback about this x)
Please let us kindly know in the discussion forum if you wish to propose further rebalances, the more specific (and the more kind) the better!

Today's update considerably buffed our monster cat - numerous fairly small but important boosts to attacks, stats (speed, HP, mana etc) and/or their upgrades, that together should make a considerable difference. Please make sure you have the new version 1.0.1 before playing to get all the monster buffs! 
Steam automatic game updates may sometimes behave a little stubbornly despite everyone's best intentions :') 

Additionally, pouncing/jumping now makes you properly immune to slowdown effects of the swamps.
We admit  it was like a bad dream where you're slowed down even when you're leaping through air while being chased by something unfriendly x') It's so much more enjoyable now to jump around in the puddles =^_^=

We're also creating some free extra content, more on that soon. 
The "Poisoned" status of the monster was designed to impair viewing the battlefield, but we will be changing its visual effects for greater accessibility.
We will be rebalancing and improving the game further after this update (together with new free content) as planned.

Quick tips to take with you:
1. All monster paw attacks can deflect incoming arrows (it takes a bit of practice)
2. Not moving after/while using the palm lightning spell (a high level magic) causes extra rays to appear one by one, increasing your magical attack power up to five times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/f9edd1332730854bcfe84a4e60b0009a61d1deb1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire[/b] is out now!

Check out this fresh trailer full of rampage and destruction:
[previewyoutube=KfIUjZixRgU;full][/previewyoutube]
As you're probably aware by now, Monster Run is a dark fantasy roguelite'ish beat-em-up where you're a giant fire breathing monster cat, personally fighting vs large medieval armies.

After waking from a 100-year sleep and seeing how the new greedy human empire ravages your forests and lands, you’ve decided to personally obliterate it. Demolish its castles, kings, armies comprised of hundreds of soldiers, and every other last piece of imperial might.

Here are some of the features you can expect:
[list]
[*] Fight as a giant monster cat against massive human armies, minibosses, and wizards.
[*] 66+ different enemy unit types.
[*] More than 100+ upgrades, including more than 10 new unique abilities & attacks.
[*] Epic Campaign: Enjoy a single-player campaign with over 21 missions.
[*] Evolving map: each time you start a new run, various missions will be switched with new, alternative missions.
[*] Destructible environments: human-made constructions (including furniture, towers, castles, etc) are fully destructible.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire as much as we loved creating it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394300/Monster_Run_Downfall_of_the_Empire/

notes.title: Monster Run's New Demo is Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/01898fa5f32c3129e70070fc37f22290ce7a2ff0.png[/img]

Hey everyone, 

Unlike our titular monster, we haven’t been hibernating. We’ve been working hard on getting the game into the best possible shape, and we’re more than excited for all of you to get another taste of what we’ve been building over the past few months, which is why [b]we’re back with a brand-new demo for Monster Run! [/b]

We’re bringing a whole arsenal of new features to bring you an experience that is more thrilling than last time you got to play Monster Run in a demo that will be live until June 17th, 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/dc55b0d6ce26461bc1bd2d53b28cbf44d8663b61.gif[/img]

[h3]So, what’s new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Explore and Destroy:[/b] Master your skills across 9 distinct levels, each more challenging than the last.
[*] A New World Awaits: Navigate through a newly designed world map - filled with imperial armies and fully destroyable castles defending their little evil empire.
[*] [b]Unleash the Beast:[/b] With over 12 different monster attacks, combos, and spells at your pawtips, no battle will ever be the same.
[*] [b]Seamless Control:[/b] Controller support has now been implemented, ensuring a smooth and intuitive gameplay experience, letting you fully immerse in the chaos comfortably from your couch.
[*] [b]Meet Your Match:[/b] Fight with 33+ unique units who try to bring you down not only by sheer mass but also cunning tactics. Try the permadeath experience.
[*] [b]Discover the joy of breathing fire:[/b] Unleash new magical abilities like shooting lightning from your paws and levitating small objects, telekinetically throwing them at your enemies.
[/list]
We're thrilled for you to see what we've been creating [b]and eagerly await your feedback[/b]! Keep an eye out for more updates and get ready for an epic adventure! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394300/Monster_Run/

notes.title: Monster Run's Next Demo Opportunity!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/6be8519d2bd74d16288b123f6c746058679e59ba.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We know it's been a quiet few months since our last update in February, and we sincerely appreciate your patience. Behind the scenes, we've been tirelessly sharpening our claws and fluffing our fur for something big. We’re thrilled to announce that an updated demo of Monster Run will be released next Wednesday, June 12th!

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
Dive into an even more thrilling adventure with this demo, which packs a punch with its plethora of new features:
[list]
[*] [b]Explore and Destroy[/b]: Master your skills across 9 distinct levels, each more challenging than the last.
[*] [b]A New World Awaits[/b]: Navigate through a newly designed world map - filled with imperial armies and fully destroyable castles defending their little evil empire.
[*] [b]Unleash the Beast[/b]: With over 12 different monster attacks, combos, and spells at your pawtips, no battle will ever be the same.
[*] [b]Seamless Control[/b]: Controller support has now been implemented, ensuring a smooth and intuitive gameplay experience, letting you fully immerse in the chaos comfortably from your couch.
[*] [b]Meet Your Match[/b]: Fight with 33+ unique units who try to bring you down not only by sheer mass but also cunning tactics. Try the permadeath experience. 
[*] [b]Discover the joy of breathing fire[/b]: Unleash new magical abilities like shooting lightning from your paws and levitating small objects, telekinetically casting/throwing them at your enemies.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/ff3f4707336ad4007b9c08af6d6119ad7a9b63b9.jpg[/img]
We're incredibly excited for you to experience what we’ve been working on and can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare yourself for a monstrous adventure. The chaos awaits—are you ready to run?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2394300/Monster_Run/
